paragraphs: Rabbi Banei, in Huna’s name, Midrash Shmuel 14; Ruth 1; Kohelet, “Do not be overly righteous”: Benayah and Chuna. Chinena bar Yanta in his name. Banei; Yochanan in his name, Jerusalem Nedarim 6; Nazir 8. I think the above Bena'ah.
